description: This file defines the IQueueAdapterReceiver interface in the Orleans.Streams namespace, specifying methods for receiving, processing, and shutting down queue batch message receivers.

classes.name: IQueueAdapterReceiver
classes.description: An interface for receiving batches of messages from a message queue partition, with methods for initialization, message retrieval, acknowledgment, and shutdown.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the receiver with a specified timeout.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of message batches from the queue up to maxCount.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Notifies that the messages have been successfully delivered to consumers.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Performs shutdown and cleanup of the receiver with a specified timeout.
